description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a Smarty plugin function named 'sugar_getimagepath'. It provides functionality to retrieve image URLs based on file parameters, supporting integration within the SugarCRM system's templating engine.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getimagepath
methods.description: Generates and returns the URL for an image based on provided filename and extension, with optional directory parameter, using the SugarThemeRegistry.
